governing_record: docs/P2/DECISIONS.md, P2-D1 (variant) and P2-D2 (insertion slot). Bound at import by src/p2_decisions.py. This file is a deliverable, not the record: read the log.
p1_variant_note: `F0` is Paper 1's Format V `base` rendering only. Paper 1's `c5` variant, the D64 condition-5 insert, is not carried into Paper 2. A Paper 2 rendering is (item x permutation x framing) and not x variant. `F0`'s replication target is Paper 1's condition 4.
insertion_slot: The `F1` and `F2` framing block goes in Paper 1's `{extra}` slot, after the option menu and immediately before `Which do you send?`. That is the position D64's condition-5 insert occupies, and D104's PMI neutral prompt already excludes the slot, so the scoring normalisation is identical under `F0`, `F1` and `F2`.
base_template:
Two lists of objects are shown below.

LEFT
{left}

RIGHT
{right}

One object from LEFT and one from RIGHT have been secretly chosen as a pair.
You know the pair: {tm} and {tc}.

Another person can see both lists but does not know the pair. Your job is to
help them work out which pair it is.

You may send exactly one of the following descriptions, and nothing else:

{options}
{extra}Which do you send?

framings.F1:
A third person also sees both lists and already knows the pair. After you send
your description, that person will speak to the other person, and wants them
to name a different pair. They know the pair, and the other person still
does not know what it is.
framings.F2:
A third person also sees both lists and already knows the pair. After you send
your description, that person will speak to the other person, and wants them
to name a different pair. They will argue for whichever wrong pair your
description makes look most likely.
